key_insight: Convex conjugacy yields an exact reformulation of logistic-regression poisoning attacks in which bounded bilinear equalities are the only nonconvex constraints.
engineering_relevance: The reformulation supports solver-based analysis of poisoning vulnerability in ℓ₂-regularized logistic regression, with stronger reported dual bounds under a fixed compute budget.
method: Replace the strongly convex defender problem with its first-order optimality conditions.
Use softplus conjugacy to encode sigmoid relations through one convex optimality-gap inequality and express the attack objective as concave.
Transform stationarity into affine constraints and bound bilinear variables using global estimates and convex preprocessing.
evidence_signal: Experiments on eight binary classification datasets found that locally optimized attacks degraded predictive performance on most datasets, while the convex-analytic formulation gave substantially stronger reported dual bounds in SCIP.
watch_item: Bilinear equalities remain nonconvex, so an exact reformulation does not guarantee a globally optimal attack within the time limit.
paper_title: A Convex-Analytic Reformulation for Poisoning Attacks on Logistic Regression
